name: document-analysis-workspace
title: 多文档审阅与对比工作台：架构与首版闭环
description: 先评审多文档审阅与对比工作台架构，再实现结构化证据、有限单 Agent、矩阵复核和交付闭环。
creator: developer
notes: Architecture approved. A0-A4 are a locally validated engineering candidate: structured evidence, fixed and bounded-Agent execution, exact review/static delivery, dependency invalidation and conservative cross-snapshot reuse pass controlled PostgreSQL/HTTP/browser checks. A1 negative coverage, one software validation pack, one football-shirt cross-domain holdout pack, the independent trial kit, the holdout scorer and the 4C4G runner are ready. Both frozen packs now have 30-row assistant reviewer drafts with source anchors and error rules; these drafts are not independent labels and are excluded from model input. The live holdout preflight is blocked by missing analysis auth, disabled execution/uploads and an unconfigured fixed route. Runner validation does not establish real-model quality or production capacity. Status remains in_progress because real-model holdout quality, external 4C4G target-resource acceptance and independent customer UAT are still open. No deployment, production migration or external model call was performed.
